entries.zh: 创造并处理材料，以提高其实用性和耐用性。
entries.en: The creation and manipulation of materials for increased utility and durability.

entries.zh: 一项关于推进技术和弹道技术的研究
entries.en: The study of propulsion and trajectory.

entries.zh: 太空是终极边界，掌握它就掌握了未来。
entries.en: Space is the final frontier. To master it is to master the future.

entries.zh: 迫使基本力遵从我们的意志。
entries.en: Bending fundamental forces to our will.

entries.zh: 隔绝并利用微粒物质和现象。
entries.en: Isolating and utilizing particulate matter and phenomena.

entries.zh: 打造一个成功社会的艺术。
entries.en: The art of building a successful society.

entries.zh: 研究纷繁的形式与复杂性生命的科学
entries.en: The science of life, in its many forms and complexities.

entries.zh: 战争的艺术及其诸重要方面。
entries.en: The art of war and its many important aspects.

entries.zh: 超光速航行的实现带来了太空时代的曙光。跨星系载人航行现在不再仅仅是可能，而是变成一种必要的技术。
entries.en: The realization of faster-than-light travel is a new dawn for space exploration. Manned missions to other star systems are now not only possible, but necessary.

entries.zh: 超光速航行技术的突破将使得我们将传统的地空军用穿梭机最终改造成体型相对小，速度快，操纵性强但是火力有限的机动战舰。
entries.en: The FTL breakthrough allowed early attempts to adapt traditional surface-to-space shuttle frames to military applications to finally create relatively small, fast, and maneuverable vessels with limited firepower.

entries.zh: 尽管比护卫舰大一些，但是驱逐舰的船体结构仍使它仍不失为一种较为灵活的炮艇。
entries.en: While larger than Corvettes, Destroyer hull configurations still make for comparatively nimble gunboats.

entries.zh: 这种船体结构最初设计为下一代试验型殖民船，其丰富的挂载点使得其能够理想地携带重武器及弹药。
entries.en: Originally devised as an experimental next-generation colony ship hull configuration, the design's ample hardpoints made it ideal for carrying heavy weapons ordnance.

entries.zh: 作为最大的标准化军用战舰，战列舰自然配备了厚重的装甲和数个移动炮塔。
entries.en: The largest of the standard military vessels, Battleships are traditionally heavily armored and sport several gun batteries.

entries.zh: 设计这种规模的战舰，可以结合卓越的火力和尖端的辅助，达到摧枯拉朽的效果。泰坦型战舰可充当全能的旗舰，也可支援周围的舰船，抑或诱敌深入。
entries.en: Designing ships at this scale allows for a deadly combination of exceptional firepower and cutting-edge auxiliary support. Titan configurations may serve as highly versatile flagships which are also capable of bolstering surrounding vessels or ensnaring hostiles.

entries.zh: 巨构工程学的进步孕育出了巨像型战舰，模糊了现实与幻想的界限。只需按下按钮，这些巨大的单一武器平台就能凭一己之力改变或抹去一整个世界。
entries.en: Advances in mega-engineering blur the lines between reality and fantasy in the form of Colossus-type military vessels. These immense, single-weapon platforms are capable of radically altering or obliterating entire worlds at the push of a button.

entries.zh: 建造技术的进步将使得我们能够进行更坚固更耐用的护卫舰的建造。
entries.en: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable corvettes.

entries.zh: 最新一代的护卫舰优化了结构的整体性并改进了舱壁。
entries.en: The latest generation of corvette hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.

entries.zh: 建立新的护卫舰模板和建造标准将会大大提高生产线的效率。
entries.en: Establishing new standards for the modeling and construction of corvettes greatly improves the efficiency of the production pipeline.

entries.zh: 建造技术的进步将使得我们能够进行更坚固更耐用的驱逐舰的建造。
entries.en: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable destroyers.

entries.zh: 新一代的驱逐舰优化了结构的整体性并改进了舱壁。
entries.en: The latest generation of destroyer hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.

entries.zh: 建立新的驱逐舰模板和建造标准将会大大提高生产线的效率。
entries.en: Establishing new standards for the modeling and construction of destroyers greatly improves the efficiency of the production pipeline.

entries.zh: 建造技术的进步将使得我们能够进行更坚固更耐用的巡洋舰的建造。
entries.en: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable cruisers.

entries.zh: 最新一代的巡洋舰优化了结构的整体性并改进了舱壁。
entries.en: The latest generation of cruiser hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.

entries.zh: 建立新的巡洋舰模板和建造标准将会大大提高生产线的效率。
entries.en: Establishing new standards for the modeling and construction of cruisers greatly improves the efficiency of the production pipeline.

entries.zh: 建造技术的进步将使得我们能够进行更坚固更耐用的战列舰的建造。
entries.en: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable battleships.

entries.zh: 最新一代的战列舰优化了结构的整体性并改进了舱壁。
entries.en: The latest generation of battleship hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.

entries.zh: 建立新的战列舰模板和建造标准将会大大提高生产线的效率。
entries.en: Establishing new standards for how we design and construct massive battleships greatly improves the speed at which they can be assembled.

entries.zh: 建造技术的进步将使得我们能够进行更坚固更耐用的泰坦的建造。
entries.en: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable titans.

entries.zh: 最新一代的泰坦已经改善了结构的整体性并改进了舱壁。
entries.en: The latest generation of titan hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.

entries.zh: 为了充分利用恒星系中的资源，我们必须在星系主星较近的轨道附近建立一个集中化的太空设施。
entries.en: A centralized space installation built in close orbit around the system primary is necessary to make full use of the resources in a star system.

entries.zh: 初期的恒星基地只不过是临时的前哨站。而永久性的星港能够让我们保证对恒星系的牢固控制。
entries.en: The earliest starbases were little more than makeshift outposts. Permanent starports will enable us to maintain a firmer grip on star systems.

entries.zh: 随着太空交通流量的增加，我们需要更大更可靠的恒星基地来保证对恒星系航道的控制。
entries.en: As space traffic increases, larger and more defensible starbases are needed to maintain control over system spacelanes.

entries.zh: 这些强大的太空堡垒将为恒星系中所有的军事活动提供一个据点，它们的存在几乎足以阻挡住最顽强的进攻者。
entries.en: These mighty space forts will provide a focal point for all military activity in a star system, and their presence is sure to deter all but the most stubborn attackers.

entries.zh: 一个用一座巨型军用空间站就能抵挡数支攻击舰队的构想正在制定当中。一旦实现，这些擎天堡将会成为恒星系中心的伟大纪念碑。
entries.en: Plans for an immense battlestation capable of holding its own against several strike fleets are now being drawn up. If realized, these citadels will become monuments to greatness as much as system hubs.

entries.zh: 优化恒星基地的建造流程，使用模块化设计，这将可以减少目前建造的花费和时间。
entries.en: Streamlined starbase construction procedures, using modular designs, will reduce the present build cost and time.

entries.zh: 强化过的构架与增强了冲击吸收能力的防爆护盾即使在巨大的压力下，也可以确保平台的结构完整性。
entries.en: A reinforced framework and blast shields with enhanced impact absorption will ensure the structural integrity of the platform even under immense pressure.

entries.zh: 先进的太阳能板科技可以抵消恒星基地的运行成本。不过，这些太阳能板需要占用一个恒星基地的模块才能生产足够规模的能源。
entries.en: Advances in solar panel technology could offset the operating costs of our starbases. The panels would require an entire starbase module to generate enough energy, however.

entries.zh: 有组织的矿业工会能有效地监督恒星系内的资源开采。它可以使那些独立“盲目钻探”的矿工们得到控制，从而带来效率的提高。
entries.en: Organized mining guilds that supervise all resource extraction in a system. This leads to increased efficiency, as independent "wildcat" miners are brought to heel.

entries.zh: 这些框架配备了许多有用的工具，因此，工人在轨道工地间作业时，将更加安全快速。舱外活动任务从未如此简单。
entries.en: These frames come equipped with a multitude of useful tools, enabling workers to quickly and safely navigate orbital construction sites. E.V.A. missions in space have never been easier.

entries.zh: 短程载人舰载机，速度快，体型小，突防生存能力强。
entries.en: These manned strike craft are launched from a mothership and rely on their speed and small size to survive long enough to punch through enemy defenses.

entries.zh: 新一代舰载机装备了改进的航空电子设备，同时拥有更优良的操作性能及更强劲的武器装备。
entries.en: The next generation of strike craft, featuring improved avionics, better handling characteristics and more powerful armaments.

entries.zh: 深度改良型舰载机，性能远胜于先期版本，是每位飞行员梦寐以求的机型。
entries.en: A further refinement in strike craft design, these advanced strike craft are a pilot's dream. Their performance far exceeds that of previous models.

entries.zh: 宇宙浩瀚冰冷，觊觎谋划者狡诈无情，保护我们的家园，时刻准备着。
entries.en: There may come a time when intellects, vast and cool and unsympathetic, regard our worlds with envy and draw plans against us. We must be ready.

entries.zh: 入侵星球绝非易事。军队出征前，须先克服重大后勤补给问题。
entries.en: The invasion of another world is a staggering enterprise. There are immense logistical challenges that must be overcome before we can muster our first interplanetary armies.

entries.zh: 一次性轨道空降舱可替代脆弱的登陆艇，我军可借此快速投送轻装部队，无视地形条件。
entries.en: Single-use orbital drop pods will lessen our reliance on vulnerable landing craft and allow us to quickly land light forces anywhere on a planet's surface.

entries.zh: 加强过的纳米装甲能够提供多一层的防护，有没有这一层防护，在战斗中可能就是生与死的区别。
entries.en: Reinforced nanocomposite hull plating can provide an extra layer of protection that could be the difference between life and death in a combat situation.

entries.zh: 不同金属和陶瓷的结合物，坚硬而又不失柔韧性。
entries.en: A combination of different metals and ceramics that result in a strong armor without sacrificing flexibility.

entries.zh: 塑钢由多种塑料和金属结合而成，富有弹性。能增加舰体强度，而且造价低廉。
entries.en: Plasteel is an elastic material that combines many of the qualities of plastics and metal. It is relatively cheap to produce and can be used to augment ship armor.

entries.zh: 此种材料质地强韧、耐冲击，是合适的舰体材料。
entries.en: This strong yet flexible material is capable of withstanding severe punishment. It serves well as ship armor.

entries.zh: 中子装甲密度大、质地坚，相比常规合金装甲，中子装甲能抵抗更强大火力。
entries.en: This incredibly dense and strong material can resist firepower that would turn armor made of any other alloys into slag.

entries.zh: 灌注水晶的镀层可使船体更加耐用。
entries.en: By infusing armor plating with Crystalline matter we are able to further increase the durability of our ships' protective hulls.

entries.zh: 锻造时加入水晶材料，则合金硬度更上一层楼。
entries.en: Introducing Crystalline matter into the forging process further improves the ultra-hard qualities of crystal-infused metals.

entries.zh: 以太龙麟由多层独特矿物质纳米结构构成，具自我修复能力。采用非常规制造手段能够让我们精确仿制出这些能够自我修复的结构。
entries.en: The Ether Drake's scales are made up of multiple layers of unique mineral nanostructures. Unorthodox manufacturing techniques allow us to closely emulate these self-repairing structures.

entries.zh: 简易而有效的化学能推进器，依靠可燃推进剂来维持运作。
entries.en: Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to function.

entries.zh: 此种电推进器的推力来源于离子束，而非传统工质。
entries.en: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.

entries.zh: 等离子推进是电推进的高级形式，赋予舰船更快的亚光速航速和更好的机动性。
entries.en: An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.

entries.zh: 在亚光速条件下，此种高级聚变推进器可赋予舰船无与伦比的机动性和速度优势。
entries.en: These highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.

entries.zh: 这种强力推进器能够额外提升战斗速度，然而需要消耗巨大能源。
entries.en: These powerful thrusters provide additional combat speed but consume a great deal of power.

entries.zh: 这种改进版的标准加力燃烧室能够极大提升舰船的战斗速度。
entries.en: This improved version of the standard afterburners provide an even greater boost to a ship's combat speed.

entries.zh: 这将允许我们建设深空防御平台以保护我们的恒星基地。
entries.en: This will enable the construction of defensive deep space platforms to protect our Starbases.

entries.zh: 藉由新的施工方式，我们能够在深空中建立更大型的防御站点。
entries.en: New construction methods will allow for the construction of even larger military stations in the depths of space.

entries.zh: 这些大型的据点如同太空中漂浮的城市。数以千计的军人驻扎其中，他们的装备火力堪比一整只舰队。
entries.en: These massive installations are like cities floating in space. They can support a crew of thousands, and are often equipped with firepower rivaling that of a fleet.

entries.zh: 创建专门的舰队工兵部队会有利于深空防御平台建设，同时降低建筑成本，并提高其耐久度。
entries.en: The creation of a dedicated naval engineering corps will greatly benefit the construction of deep space defense platforms, decreasing building costs and increasing durability.

entries.zh: 深入测评现有防御站的建筑方法，发掘潜在的改良之处。
entries.en: An extensive evaluation of present military station construction methods has identified several areas of potential improvement.

entries.zh: 改变行星气候规律以压制灾难性气候现象的能力可使住房建筑更容易维护，并开放新的可居住区域。
entries.en: The ability to alter a planet's weather patterns to suppress destructive weather phenomena will make residential buildings easier to maintain and open up new areas for habitation.

entries.zh: 在指向性重力科技的帮助下，星球地表的建筑可以达到前所未有的高度，而不必担心结构崩塌。通天塔指日可待！
entries.en: With directional gravity technology, buildings on the surface of planets can reach higher than ever before without risking structural collapse. The sky is the limit!

entries.zh: 通过建立受气候制约的乡村公社，我们能够在不破坏农耕生活方式的情况下供养更多人口。
entries.en: Through the establishment of weather-controlled rural communes, we can support a larger population without disrupting our agrarian way of life.

entries.zh: 应用机械工程学进行采矿是任何工业社会的基本需求。
entries.en: The application of mechanical engineering to mineral extraction is a fundamental requirement for any industrial society.

entries.zh: 建立基础工业是远航宇宙的必要条件。
entries.en: The basic industrial infrastructure that is required to become a spacefaring civilization.

entries.zh: 外骨骼动力套装能增加穿戴者的力量和速度。其军事用途显而易见，但同样可以用来提升劳动效率。
entries.en: Wearing a powered exoskeleton suit augments the user's strength and speed. The military applications are obvious, but it will also increase labor efficiency.

entries.zh: 动力更强的电动机能增加机器人单位的载重能力。开采单位可运送更多待处理矿物，战争机器也能装载更为重型的武器。
entries.en: More powerful servomotors will increase the weight our robotic units can carry. Mining units can haul more minerals off to be processed, and war machines can be fitted with heavier armaments.

entries.zh: 新的水力压裂技术可使我们深入地壳，开采过去无法获得的地热资源。
entries.en: New fracking techniques will allow us to tap into previously unattainable pockets of geothermal resources deep beneath the planet's crust.

entries.zh: 借助这些大型钻机，我们可以开采接近地心附近常见的深层富矿。
entries.en: These massive drills are needed to access the rich mineral deposits that can often be found close to a planet's core.

entries.zh: 用先进光谱测定法配合水力压裂技术与化学冲刷，可以快速开采浅层与中层的矿脉。
entries.en: Advanced spectrometry combines with fracking techniques and chemical flushing to rapidly exploit shallow and mid-depth deposits.

entries.zh: 同步采矿网络的工作模式，进一步增加生产效率。
entries.en: By synchronizing the work patterns of our mining networks, their output efficiency can be further increased.

entries.zh: 机械工程的进一步突破需要我们下到纳米尺度。现在我们能够以前所未有的方式操纵物理系统。
entries.en: Further breakthroughs in mechanical engineering required us to descend to the nanometric scale. We are now able to manipulate physical systems in never-before-seen ways.

entries.zh: 就像有机神经元通过轴突发芽重建失去的连接一样，这些回路也有自我修复的能力。如今，再简单的计算系统也有望在使用过程中不断发展。
entries.en: Much as organic neurons reforge lost connections by means of axonal sprouting, these circuits are capable of self-overhaul. Even the simplest computing systems are now expected to evolve while in use.

entries.zh: 这些材料的量子力学特性是叠加态的关键，这是材料科学和工业技术的革命性发展。
entries.en: The quantum mechanical properties of these materials hold the key to superposition states, a revolutionary development for both material and industrial science.

entries.zh: 此种人造劳力单元是完美的廉价低端劳动力，能在简单的语音指令下完成重体力劳动，但无法胜任诸如爬楼梯等较为高级的任务。
entries.en: These artificial work units are perfect for menial labor tasks. They are hard-working and capable of following simple vocal instructions, but should not be expected to climb stairs.

entries.zh: 升级版人造单元，行动能力可与大多数有机生物相媲美。其神经处理器也进步巨大。
entries.en: Upgraded artificial units have an expanded movement range equal to that of most organics. Their neural processors have also been greatly improved.

entries.zh: 高级单元，比绝大多数有机生物更强，更快，更耐用。其神经处理器有很大提高，拥有独立运作的能力。
entries.en: Highly advanced units that are stronger, faster and more durable than the vast majority of organics. With their upgraded neural processors they are fully capable of independent operations.

entries.zh: 合成人被赋予人格后，终于能与其他人们平等地进行社会交流。有些合成人甚至能够成为领袖。
entries.en: Equipped with a personality, synthetics will finally be able to interact socially on equal terms with the rest of our citizens. Some units may even assume leadership roles.

entries.zh: 对基础的外骨骼套件进行改良后，这些整合式义体植入体能够让使用者对于有害的环境效果更具有抵抗力。
entries.en: Improving upon basic exoskeletal suits, these integrated cybernetic implants make the user more resistant to harmful environmental effects.

entries.zh: 安装能够适应当地环境的义体植入体，我方无人机的效能能够得到显著加强。
entries.en: Installing cybernetic implants that adapt to the local environment will boost the efficiency of our drones.

entries.zh: 优化开采矿物的加工流程可使我们的效率达到新的水平。
entries.en: Optimal processing of mined materials have allowed us to reach new levels of efficiency.

entries.zh: 对半精炼的矿物进行二级处理，可使矿物的存储和运输更为高效。
entries.en: Second-stage processing of pseudo-refined minerals allow for more efficient storage and transportation.

entries.zh: 通过在建筑模拟领域引入快速迭代算法，我们能够尽快确定所有建筑项目的最优装配模式。
entries.en: Rapid iteration in construction simulations determines the optimal component assembly patterns for each building project ahead of time.

entries.zh: 标准化的预制模板大大减少了实地设施的建造工期。
entries.en: Standardized pre-fab templates massively reduce on-site facility construction times.

entries.zh: 可擦写的配装模板允许我们创造定制的机器人的设计。
entries.en: Rewritable assembly templates allow for the creation of bespoke robot designs.

entries.zh: 标准化的装配模板能进一步细化机械人口的分工。
entries.en: Standardization of assembly templates allows for improved specialization of the machine population.

entries.zh: 经过改良的生成过程可以在不影响核心功能的情况下更大幅度地改造机器人。
entries.en: Improved production practices allow for greater alterations to robots without compromising core functionality.

entries.zh: 经过改良的生产过程可以在不影响核心功能的情况下对机器人进行底层改造。
entries.en: Improved production practices allow for fundamental changes to robots without compromising core functionality.

entries.zh: 通过消耗大量能量，我们可以如同无中生有一般将光转换为物质。
entries.en: By using vast amounts of energy we are able to convert light into matter from seemingly nothing.

entries.zh: 先进的装配模板系统，可以大幅提高我们装配新单位的效率。
entries.en: Advanced templates allow us to drastically increase the assembly of new units.

entries.zh: 先进的装配模板系统，可以大幅提高我们组装新机器人的效率。
entries.en: Advanced templates allow us to drastically increase the assembly of new robots.

entries.zh: 在我们能够在其他星球上建立轨道空间站之前，工程师们必须首先解决空间建设中遇到的全新的设计挑战。
entries.en: Construction in space presents our engineers with new design challenges that must be solved before we can build orbital stations above other worlds.

entries.zh: 直接在星球矿物开采处的地表进行矿物加工，能够显著提高采矿效率。
entries.en: By processing minerals directly above the world where they are extracted, our mining efficiency is substantially improved.

entries.zh: 依靠自动化机械的广泛应用，一小队骨干人员即可管理一个开采站。此举能够降低成本。
entries.en: By relying extensively on automated drones, mining stations can be operated with only a small skeleton crew. This will lower their costs.

entries.zh: 这是一种于某些星球上天然产出的刺激性气体。可代替镇静剂，对绝大多数生物都有镇静效果，也可用来当做非杀伤性的制敌手段。
entries.en: This gas is a naturally occurring stimulant found on some worlds. It has a calming effect on most beings, and can be used as a non-violent way of pacifying hostile individuals.

entries.zh: 成功建立珈蓝矿场是一项独特的考验，因为其可延展性，它的开采难度同其吸引力一样巨大。
entries.en: Establishing successful Garanthium quarries poses unique challenges, as the malleable qualities of the ore make it as difficult to mine as it is attractive.

entries.zh: 稳定粒子射线能为易爆的奥利姆矿开采提供相对安全的环境。
entries.en: Stabilization beams allow relatively safe extraction of volatile Orillium ores.

entries.zh: 开采和处理罕见的活体金属极其困难，但如果成功使用这些易变金属，获得的收益也无法估量。
entries.en: Mining and processing the rare living metals is exceedingly difficult, but successful application of the mutable alloys yields incomparable advantages.

entries.zh: 贝塞里安矿最早似乎出自单一矿源，但千年前，开始出现于星系各处。此类矿物成鹅卵石大小，群状分布，并且高度易燃。
entries.en: The Betharian minerals appear to have originated from singular source, but were scattered across the galaxy millennia ago. The minerals are most often encountered as pebble-sized clusters, and are highly flammable.

entries.zh: 在不损坏甚至是摧毁它们的前提下开采这些水晶，是一件对精密性要求很高的工作，需要极度精密的先进设备。
entries.en: Mining these crystals without damaging or even destroying them is an extremely delicate process. It requires advanced equipment capable of pinpoint precision.

entries.zh: 为了完成此等规模的建造项目，我们必须首先对与巨型结构相关的工程学和物资储备需求有基本的了解。
entries.en: To complete construction projects of truly staggering scales we must first achieve a fundamental understanding of both the engineering and resource storage requirements for such megastructures.

entries.zh: 此类电磁射弹器使用磁铁将穿甲弹丸回旋加速到极高的速度。
entries.en: These electromagnetic projectile launchers use magnets to accelerate armor-piercing rounds towards targets at high speeds.

entries.zh: 线圈炮是早期质量投射器的升级版，使用电磁线圈更有效地加速弹药。
entries.en: Coilguns are more powerful versions of the early mass drivers, using electromagnetic coils to rapidly accelerate projectiles towards targets.

entries.zh: 轨道炮是最新的电磁加速炮，轨道炮通过并行双轨加速炮弹使之以难以置信的高速发射出去。
entries.en: The latest in electromagnetic accelerators, railguns use twin parallel rails to fire projectiles at incredible speeds.

entries.zh: 经典轨道炮的新版本，使用更坚固的轨道并增加了能量配给。这些武器比之前的更强劲，更准确。
entries.en: A new version of the venerable railgun, with sturdier rails and an enhanced power supply. These weapons are even more powerful and accurate than their predecessors.

entries.zh: 在对老式电磁线圈的设计进行升级后，新版本的破坏性甚至高于最先进的轨道炮。它能够发射得更准，速度更快。
entries.en: This updated version of the old coilgun design is even more destructive than the latest railgun designs. It is capable of launching projectiles with incredible accuracy and speed.

entries.zh: 射程极远的火炮，火力猛烈，而且准确性极高。
entries.en: Very long-range artillery capable of hurling powerful rounds over extreme distances with a large degree of accuracy.

entries.zh: 更为强劲的远程舰载火力系统，装备有升级版的发射装置和火控系统。
entries.en: An even more powerful long-range, ship-based artillery cannon, equipped with a new barrel and an upgraded fire control computer.

entries.zh: 一款无比庞大的质量加速炮，只能安装在轴基武器台上。能够在极远距离射出威力惊人的炮弹。
entries.en: An enormous mass accelerator cannon that can only be placed in a spinal mount and fires monstrously powerful rounds over vast distances.

entries.zh: 更加强大的质量加速炮，能够轻易撕毁最坚固的护盾。
entries.en: An even more powerful mass accelerator cannon that can rip through even the toughest shields.

entries.zh: 大口径的弹道武器，发抛射壳炮弹。这些机炮的主要优势在于极高的射速。
entries.en: Large-caliber ballistic weapons that fire cased explosive shells. The main advantage of these cannons is their high rate of fire.

entries.zh: 这些升级版机关炮具备更完善的追踪能力和开火控制系统，因此也提升了射速。
entries.en: These upgraded rotary autocannons feature improved tracking and fire control systems. This allows them to maintain an even higher rate of fire.

entries.zh: 设计先进的自动火炮，能够向目标倾泻一片由高爆炮弹构成的弹幕。
entries.en: Advanced rotary autocannons capable of spewing a cloud of high-explosive shells at a target.

entries.zh: 高射炮可以近距离发射榴弹，这对敌人的舰载机杀伤巨大，当然也能够防御导弹。
entries.en: Gun batteries that fire shrapnel rounds at close range. They are particularly lethal to enemy strike craft, but can also defend against missiles.

entries.zh: 升级后的高射炮装备了新型更加强大的榴弹。
entries.en: Upgraded flak batteries with new, more powerful shrapnel rounds.

entries.zh: 使用预测跟踪算法和更强大的齐射，使得这些高射炮拥有了难以置信的打击敌军舰载机的能力。
entries.en: Predictive tracking algorithms and even more powerful rounds make these batteries incredibly lethal to enemy strike craft.

entries.zh: 配备有高当量核弹头的天基导弹。尽管是前太空时代的老旧技术，这种简单粗暴的制导武器在射程范围内有着惊人的高效。
entries.en: Space-to-space missiles equipped with high-yield nuclear warheads. Although based on old pre-space technology, these crude fire-and-forget weapons can be surprisingly effective at range.

entries.zh: 升级版的深空导弹，配备了更强大的核聚变弹头，飞行能力进一步提升。
entries.en: These updated space-to-space missiles have more powerful fusion warheads and improved flight performance.

entries.zh: 这些先进的导弹配备有强劲的反物质弹头。更加完善的导航系统大大提高了索敌能力。
entries.en: Advanced missiles equipped with very powerful antimatter warheads. A new and improved guidance system gives them a better chance of finding their targets.

entries.zh: 最新的深空导弹，升级之后装备了威力极度强大的弹头，它能够从真空中汲取真空零点能。
entries.en: The latest version of space-to-space missile, this upgraded variant has an immensely powerful warhead that draws its energy from a zero point vacuum.

entries.zh: 这些最尖端的导弹配备有限程度的人工智能导航，极大地提高导弹追踪目标的能力和表现。
entries.en: These highly advanced missiles are equipped with limited onboard AI pilots that substantially improve their performance and ability to track targets.

entries.zh: 这些小导弹可以集群发射，是专为克制敌人的点防御系统设计的。
entries.en: These smaller missiles are launched in volleys and have been specifically designed to overwhelm enemy point-defense systems.

entries.zh: 新的微型化技术将使得我们可以在蜂群导弹上安装更加强力的弹头，并提高飞行能力。
entries.en: New miniaturization techniques will allow us to equip swarmer missiles with more powerful warheads and improved flight performance.

entries.zh: 这些鱼雷其实都是速度缓慢的巨大导弹。它们装备了更加强大的弹头和护盾调制器，这使得它们可以安然穿过能量屏障。
entries.en: These torpedoes are essentially very large, slow-moving missiles. They are equipped with more powerful warheads and shield modulators that let them slip unmolested through energy screens.

entries.zh: 升级过后的太空鱼雷装备有装甲，可以更好地应对敌人的点防御系统。在爆炸的时候，鱼雷碎裂的装甲也会造成额外的伤害。
entries.en: Upgraded space torpedoes encased in armor, to better withstand enemy point-defense fire. The armor fragments into shards that cause additional damage when the torpedo detonates.

entries.zh: 装备有超强弹头的先进鱼雷。拥有更加光滑的设计，更快的引擎以及改良的护盾调解器，可以轻松穿过能量屏障。
entries.en: Advanced torpedoes with very powerful warheads. They have a sleeker design, faster engines and upgraded shield modulators for slipping through energy screens.

entries.zh: 数据库传输专用的高容量量子链路使得长距离完全同步传输所有的研究信息成为可能。
entries.en: High-capacity quantum bands dedicated to databank transfers make possible virtually completely synchronous research operations across vast distances.

entries.zh: 小型化的终端传输器集群安装，进一步提升了信息传输的带宽。
entries.en: Miniaturization of the endpoint transmitters allow for installing them in clusters, further increasing bandwidth.

entries.zh: 对观察现象给出可验证的预测。
在探索宇宙的过程中，我们不断发现陌生的新材料、新物质。我们需要新的设施来对这些发现进行分析与整理。
entries.en: As we explore the galaxy, we continually encounter new materials and substances that are unfamiliar to us. Cataloging and analyzing these discoveries will require new facilities.

entries.zh: 为了拓展知识库，我们必须考虑到所有层次的存在。一个新的研究领域正在等着我们！
entries.en: To expand our knowledge base, we must consider all levels of existence. A new realm of science awaits us!

entries.zh: 量子计算机的处理速度超越了传统的极限，潜力无限。这项革命性的技术预示着一个巨大的飞跃，进入未知的解决问题的领域。
entries.en: With processing speeds that defy classical limits, the potential of quantum computers is boundless. This revolutionary technology heralds a great leap into uncharted regions of problem-solving.

entries.zh: 宇宙的基本力可以通过物理场来调节。掌握了这个过程，我们就可以扮演上帝的角色——至少在科学实验室的范围内是这样。
entries.en: The fundamental forces of the universe can be mediated by physical fields. Mastering this process allows us to play as gods - at least within the confines of the science lab.

entries.zh: 早在我们抵达繁星之前，我们就知道了重力和时间是联系在一起的。现在，我们对这种独特关系的理解已经达到了一个临界点，能以前所未见的规模操纵作用力。
entries.en: We knew gravity and time were linked long before we reached the stars. Now, our understanding of this unique relationship has reached a tipping point, allowing us to manipulate forces on a previously unimaginable scale.

entries.zh: 逻辑电路经特殊重组后有着相当的学术热情。
新的子例程能够增强我们的研究单位的注意力并消灭低效性。
entries.en: New subroutines will sharpen the focus of our research units and eliminate inefficiency.

entries.zh: 演进人工智能是追求合成智能的必由之路。
entries.en: Evolving artificial intellects are opening the door to the possibility for true synthetic sapience.

entries.zh: 谋而后动。我们的思维将更上一层楼。
entries.en: Thought before action. Our Mind will evolve to ever greater heights.

entries.zh: 有限控制论，无限可能性。
entries.en: Expanding possibilities through the application of limited cybernetics.
Opening new avenues of synthetic thought.

entries.zh: 根据特定任务主动调试矩阵，能令战斗事半功倍。
entries.en: Active matrices tuned for specific combat-centric tasks greatly improve engagement efficiency.

entries.zh: 预测算法更进一步，战场决策胜人一筹。
entries.en: Further advances in predictive algorithms allow for augmented tactical decision-making in the field.

entries.zh: 智慧人工智能在经过高强度战争模拟试验后对于风险评估技术的潜在优化有着宝贵的洞察力。
entries.en: Running sapient AIs through high-intensity combat simulations yields valuable insight into potential optimizations for risk-evaluation techniques.

entries.zh: 赋予舰船以半自主智能，增强其战场响应能力。
entries.en: Granting our ships their own semi-autonomous intellect will greatly enhance their responsiveness in combat.
The best defense is a good offense.

entries.zh: 经验证，防御武器阵列比自主防御体系更有效。
entries.en: Arrays of defensive armaments prove much more effective than independent countermeasures.

entries.zh: 推动预测系统进步，提升主动防御精确度。
entries.en: Advanced prediction greatly increases the accuracy of active countermeasure systems.

entries.zh: 统一防御和攻击武器使用规范以提高效率。
entries.en: Aligning defensive and offensive weapon execution paradigms allows for increased efficiency.

entries.zh: 注资行星际资源库，灵活审批研究计划。
entries.en: A bid for interplanetary resource pools and more flexible research grants.

entries.zh: 先进的神经植入体连接着量子计算集群，让人能够进行并行思考。
entries.en: Advanced neurological implants with connection to quantum computing clusters allow for multi-threaded thoughts.

entries.zh: 将殖民船交由机载电脑，而船员和殖民者可以进入假死状态。
entries.en: By giving control of the colony ship to the on-board computer, the crew and colonists can be placed in suspended animation.

entries.zh: 通过在新殖民地的原生土壤中预先培育新幼苗，我们可以加快其适应过程。
entries.en: By first incubating our new seedlings in the native soils of new colonies we can speed up the acclimatization process.

entries.zh: 在殖民船的货舱中储备数队小型建筑无人机。到达行星地表后启动，大幅促进初期殖民。
entries.en: Fleets of small but efficient construction drones that are stored in the cargo bays of colony ships. Once activated on a planetary surface, they greatly speed up the initial settlement process.

entries.zh: 相当先进的系统，知悉目标后，能自动选择执行最优方案。
entries.en: Sufficiently advanced systems are capable of optimizing themselves if they are made acutely aware of the purpose for which they were made.

entries.zh: 永久维持能够适应所有气候类型的特种苗木，可大幅缩短我们创建新世界所需的时间。
entries.en: Permanently maintaining specialized seedlings capable of surviving all types of climates massively decreases the time it takes us to create new worlds.

entries.zh: 先进的人工智能可以辅助科学专员探索新的世界、寻找新的生命和新的文明、以及前往从未有任何布洛葛去过的地方。通过人工智能的帮助，科研船可以探索宇宙。
entries.en: An advanced AI will aid science officers in their task to explore strange new worlds, to seek out new life and new civilizations, to boldly go where no Blorg has gone before. The Science Ship will be able to explore the galaxy with help from an AI.

entries.zh: 探索单位的算法更新换代后，勘察更快，并可在无中央机械智能指示时自主探索深空。
entries.en: Updated and more advanced algorithms will not only speed up surveying, but also permit our exploration assets to spend more time in deep space without continuous instructions from the central Machine Intelligence.

entries.zh: 异星天然气可以人工生产，但是较为困难，需要先进的精炼设备。
entries.en: Exotic Gas can be produced artificially, but it is a difficult process that requires advanced refinery equipment.

entries.zh: 除了明显的安全问题之外，人造易爆微粒本身就是极端精密且复杂的工作，需要高度专业化的设备。
entries.en: Aside from the obvious safety concerns, the artificial creation of Volatile Motes is an extremely delicate and complicated process that requires highly specialized equipment.

entries.zh: 结晶化的过程复杂且困难，但只要有专门的生产工厂，我们就可以生产人工制造水晶。
entries.en: The crystallization process is complicated and difficult, but synthetic crystals can be manufactured by using specialized industrial plants.

entries.zh: 超高密度中子实质可用于锻造高强度、高耐久装甲。
entries.en: Neutronium is a super-dense substance composed of neutrons that can be forged into extremely resistant and durable armor.

entries.zh: 这种独特的物质具有许多打破物理原理的特性。仅在黑洞周围或部分星云附近能获得。
entries.en: This exotic substance has many properties that seemingly defy the laws of physics. Harvestable concentrations can only be found near Black Holes or in certain nebulas.

entries.zh: 引发核裂变为舰船提供能源，但同时也会生成有害核废料。
entries.en: This energy source generates power for ships through induced fission, but it also produces harmful nuclear waste.

entries.zh: 核聚变可为舰船提供大量能源，且风险小于裂变。
entries.en: Nuclear fusion processes generate a great amount of power for ships, but without many of the risks associated with fission power.

entries.zh: 低温核聚变技术将促进新一代舰载聚变反应堆诞生。
entries.en: The ability to sustain a fusion reaction at relatively low temperatures will result in a new generation of fusion reactors for our ships.

entries.zh: 利用正反物质结合产生舰船能源，效率远超核聚变。
entries.en: By harnessing the energy produced by matter/antimatter annihilations, our efficiency at generating ship power will be orders of magnitude better than fusion.

entries.zh: 提取真空零点能是目前最高效的产能方式，可以近乎无限地供应舰船能源。
entries.en: These generators extract vacuum energy, providing an almost limitless supply of ship power. There is no more efficient way to generate energy.

entries.zh: 以某种违背物理法则的方法，直接从暗物质中汲取巨量能源，为舰船供能。
entries.en: These generators appear to somehow draw energy directly from dark matter, providing more ship power than should be possible according to the laws of physics.

entries.zh: 能量偏射屏障可在过载前化解一定敌方火力，主要缺点是能耗高。
entries.en: Energy deflector screens can stop a limited amount of incoming enemy fire before overloading. Their main drawback is that they consume large amounts of power.

entries.zh: 升级能量偏射屏障，在过载前化解更多火力。
entries.en: These updated deflector screens are capable of soaking up even more punishment before they overload.

entries.zh: 新型护盾生成器是新一代能量屏障，取代旧式能量偏转器，提供更优秀的防护能力。
entries.en: These new shield generators represent the next generation of energy screens, replacing the older deflector technology. They offer significantly better protection.

entries.zh: 升级护盾生成器以制造出更强能量场。只有持续不断的火力可以击穿此屏障。
entries.en: An updated shield generator that produces an even stronger energy field. Only sustained enemy fire can penetrate this barrier.

entries.zh: 加强、加固能源护盾，提供首屈一指的防护能力。
entries.en: These reinforced and hardened energy shields are incredibly powerful. The protection they offer is second to none.

entries.zh: 储能电容器可用于增强舰船护盾。
entries.en: These capacitors store surplus energy which can quickly be transferred to reinforce a ship's shields.

entries.zh: 在行星大气层中制造出强大护盾比在真空中困难，但能够有效防护轨道轰炸。
entries.en: Generating a strong energy shield within a planetary atmosphere is a greater challenge than in the vacuum of space, but it offers a potent defense against orbital bombardment.

entries.zh: 这些偏导护盾利用暗物质以一种似乎完全违反自然规律的方式偏转来袭的炮火。
entries.en: These deflectors utilize dark matter to deflect incoming projectiles in a way that seems to utterly defy the laws of nature.

entries.zh: 这种极端强大的护盾是由一个
entries.en: These extremely powerful shields are generated out of pure psionic energy by a cadre of

entries.zh: 。其防护能力还可以用大型灵能发射阵列来进一步增强。
entries.en: . Their powers are further augmented by large arrays of psi emitters.

entries.zh: 是通过将纯灵能从虚境中导出而具现化的
entries.en: were materialized through the channeling of pure psionic energy from the Shroud
These barriers are generated out of pure psionic energy by a cadre of

entries.zh: 组用纯粹的灵能生成的。它可以阻挡一些敌方火力，就像我们的偏导护盾系统一样，不过无需耗费大量的能量。
entries.en: . They will be able to stop some incoming fire, like our energy deflector systems, but without the prohibitive power consumption.

entries.zh: 这些传感器已经过调整，可以检测太空中的任何引力变化，例如由舰船出现导致的力场扭曲波动。
entries.en: These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.

entries.zh: 这些传感器能检测到旅行舰船启动后遗留的亚空间波动。它们的灵敏度和范围比重力传感器阵列更大。
entries.en: Sensors that detect the subspace fluctuations left in the wake of traveling starships. Their sensitivity and range is greater than that of a gravitic sensor array.

entries.zh: 先进的传感器依靠旋转的快子束，即使在极远距离也能检测船舶运动。
entries.en: Advanced sensors that rely on rotating tachyon beams to detect ship movements even at extreme distances.

entries.zh: 可添加到轨道太空港结构中的强力传感器阵列。它们的传感器将周边区域完美覆盖。
entries.en: Powerful sensor arrays that can be added to the structure of orbital spaceports. They provide excellent sensor coverage of the surrounding region of space.

entries.zh: 可以储存巨量能源的电容器是现代文明的基础。
entries.en: Capacitors capable of storing vast amounts of energy is one of the cornerstones for any modern civilization.

entries.zh: 调整过的力场可以增加能源产量并提高能源输出。
entries.en: Modulated fields allow for increased production and improved energy yield.

entries.zh: 基本的纠缠理论在能量生产中的应用使得能源输出量大幅增加。
entries.en: Basic entanglement principles applied to energy generation provide a substantial increase in energy output.

entries.zh: 处于量子叠加态下的能量线圈，可同时充放电。
entries.en: Quantum superposition of energy coils, simultaneously drained and charged.

entries.zh: 负载平衡设施可以大幅提升本地电网的稳定性，并将多余的能源返还中央电容器。
entries.en: Load-balancing facilities can greatly improve the stability of local grids and feed excess power back into centralized capacitors.

entries.zh: 重新设计后统一的电网将会进一步减少远距离传输的能源损耗。
entries.en: A re-engineered and unified grid further reduces energy losses over distance.

entries.zh: 在亚空间中打通连接，可以在正常空间中两个不同点之间建立一条临时通道。点与点之间的穿梭将是几乎瞬时的。
entries.en: By tunneling directly through subspace, a temporary conduit can be established between two different points in normal space. Travel between these points would be near instantaneous.

entries.zh: 要创建稳定的虫洞需要花费时间和大量的能源，但是这个过程可以通过使用一种特殊的校准仪来优化。
entries.en: The creation of a stable wormhole takes time and requires massive amounts of energy, but the process can be streamlined with the use of special calibrators.

entries.zh: 这些控制场允许我们在无惧触发突如其来的亚空间能量串级的风险下，创造更强大的虫洞。
entries.en: These containment fields allow for the creation of more powerful wormholes without the risk of triggering a sudden subspace energy cascade.

entries.zh: 就像蜘蛛网上的丝线一样，多维空间的其他维度在大多数恒星的重力井之间运动。在这些超空间航道间理论上是可以进行超光速旅行的。
entries.en: Like the strands of a spider web, the extra-dimensional realm of hyperspace runs between the gravity wells of most stars. Faster than light travel is theoretically possible along these hyperlanes.

entries.zh: 我们已经确定太空中有能使舰船消耗更少的能源“突破”并进入一个超空间航道的点的存在。这将产生新一代的超级引擎。
entries.en: We have identified the existence of points in space where a ship expends less energy to "breach" their way into a hyperlane. This will lead to a new generation of hyper drives.

entries.zh: 新一代的超级引擎能够通过超空间中存在的亚空间滑流。这使得引擎的性能显着提高。
entries.en: A new generation of hyper drives capable of accessing the subspace slipstreams that are present within hyperspace. This leads to dramatically improved drive performance.

entries.zh: 虽然我们不通过超空间旅行，但绘制星系宽广的超空间航道网络在我们对付那些使用航道的人时将带来明显的优势。
entries.en: Although we do not travel through hyperspace, mapping the galaxy's extensive hyperlane network gives us a clear advantage against those who do.

entries.zh: 用曲速场包裹舰船，形成一个亚空间泡泡，理论上来说就可以超越光速了。
entries.en: By enveloping a vessel in a warp field and forming a subspace bubble around it, velocities exceeding the speed of light are theoretically possible.

entries.zh: 改进的曲速场稳定技术将使我们的舰船航行更远的同时花费更少的能源。
entries.en: Improved stabilization techniques for warp fields will enable our ships to travel farther while expending less energy.

entries.zh: 这些革命性的冲压发动机装在曲速引擎上起到粒子收集器的作用，不断补充舰船的燃料供应。
entries.en: These revolutionary ramscoops are attached to warp drives and function as particle collectors, replenishing a starship's fuel supply.

entries.zh: 一项开创性科技奇迹，跃迁引擎可以粉碎当地的时空连续性并在量子层面上重组至与目标地点完全相同的状态，于是这艘舰船基几乎在一瞬间完成了星系间的“跃迁”。
entries.en: A groundbreaking technological marvel, the Jump Drive shreds the local space-time continuum and rearranges it on the quantum level to be identical to that of the target destination - and thus the ship appears to near-instantly "jump" from system to system.

entries.zh: 灵能跳跃引擎利用船员放射的灵能使舰体穿越现实的空间结构，立即“跳跃”过超长的距离。
entries.en: The Psi Jump Drive harnesses the psi energies emitted by the crew to force the vessel through the very fabric of reality, instantly "jumping" vast distances.

entries.zh: 天然产生的虫洞变幻无常，而其波动的能级通常使舰船无法安全地穿行其连接的开口。不过，暂时稳定其基体的方法还是存在的。
entries.en: A naturally occurring subspace wormhole is a fickle thing, and its fluctuating energy levels typically make it impossible to travel safely between its linked apertures. There are ways to temporarily stabilize its matrix, however.

entries.zh: 激活在星系中四散的废弃星门空间站的能力，可以极大地缩短星际旅行的时间。
entries.en: The ability to reactivate the derelict Gateway stations that can be found scattered throughout the galaxy has the potential to dramatically shorten travel times.

entries.zh: 建造新的星门空间站使我们可以建立一个快速通行网络，给星际通行带来革命。
entries.en: The construction of new Gateway stations enables us to build a fast-travel network that could revolutionize interstellar travel.

entries.zh: 限域性带电粒子场可以为耗尽的护盾电容充能。
entries.en: Localized fields of charged particles can energize depleted shield capacitors.

entries.zh: 量子去稳器可以扰动局部的量子场，干扰敌方舰船上敏感的定位设备。
entries.en: Quantum Destabilizers agitate the local quantum field, disturbing sensitive targeting equipment aboard hostile ships.

entries.zh: 向一个局部区域灌输随机调制的弱电磁脉冲，敌人的护盾和武器系统会受到部分干扰。
entries.en: By flooding a localized area with weak, randomly-modulated electromagnetic pulses, enemy shield and weapons systems can be partially disrupted.

entries.zh: 神秘编码器在将飞行路径数据返回舰队指挥中心前，会根据某种未知的法则对数据进行加密。
entries.en: The Enigmatic Encoder scrambles flight path data according to some indeterminable design before feeding it back to fleet command.

entries.zh: 虽然神秘解码器在标准测试中表现平平，但目标的飞行路径越不规则，该解码器预测算法的准确度似乎就越高。
entries.en: While producing average results in standard tests, the accuracy of Enigmatic Decoder's prediction algorithms seemingly increases as the target's flight path grows more erratic.

entries.zh: 我们的历史就是一个不断螺旋上升的过程。每次循环中，我们的科技、政治和文化水平都会出现飞跃式的发展。这些飞跃通常都出现在动乱之后，随后又带来相对平稳的时代。通过甄别这样的核心前提，我们也许能够大大缩短循环的时间，这样有利于缩短我们的发展周期。
entries.en: Our history is a repeating cycle of dramatic technological, political, and cultural leaps; these leaps are often preceded by periods of upheaval and followed by times of relative stability. By identifying the core, recurring premises of these leaps, we may be able to effectively short-circuit the cycle for our own benefit.

entries.zh: 激光武器可以向目标发射聚焦光束，通过高热量给敌方造成伤害。
entries.en: Laser weapons fire focused beams of light at targets, causing damage through the generation of intense heat.

entries.zh: 比红色激光器更加强大，对有机生物来说，这种波长的电磁辐射看上去是蓝色或紫色的。
entries.en: More powerful than red lasers, these blue variants emit electromagnetic radiation at a wavelength that appears blue or violet to most organics.

entries.zh: 紫外激光器是它的前身蓝激光器的更新强化版本。这些武器精准而充满毁灭性，可以造成巨大的杀伤。
entries.en: Ultraviolet lasers are an updated and more powerful version of their blue predecessors. Accurate and destructive, these weapons are capable of inflicting great damage.

entries.zh: 这种激光的波长较紫外线短一些，但是更具毁灭性。
entries.en: These lasers have a shorter wavelength than UV-based laser weaponry, but are even more destructive.

entries.zh: 伽马激光的电磁辐射频率极高。在激光武器领域，其破坏力是无可比拟的。
entries.en: The electromagnetic radiation emitted by gamma lasers is of an extremely high frequency. Their destructive potential is unmatched in the field of laser weapons.

entries.zh: 这些重型能量武器能够发射聚焦的粒子射线并造成巨幅伤害。发射阵列的规模限制了它们只能运用在战列舰和泰坦上。
entries.en: These heavy energy weapons fire focused particle beams that cause massive damage. The size of the emitter arrays limits their use to battleships and titans.

entries.zh: 粒子光矛更为强力的版本，该武器发射携带有巨大能量的快子光束。和它的之前版本一样，只能运用在战列舰和泰坦上。
entries.en: A more powerful version of the particle lance, this weapon fires a tachyon beam of immense power. Like its predecessor, its use is limited to battleships and titans.

entries.zh: 一个巨大的串联能源增幅导管阵列，可以发射一道威力前所未有的光束。它的尺寸意味着只有泰坦级星舰才能装得上。
entries.en: A massive array of linked energy amplification conduits that fires a beam of unprecedented firepower. Its size means that it can only be fitted on Titan-class starships.

entries.zh: 可以向目标发射毁灭性的高能等离子球体的武器。这种等离子抛射体在对付大型舰船的装甲时特别有效。
entries.en: Weapons that eject destructive balls of high-energy plasma at targets. These plasma projectiles are extremely effective at eating through ship armor.

entries.zh: 这种新的加速炮利发射具有更先进约束场的高能等离子体。这种技术可以降低等离子体向目标飞行过程中所逸散的能量。
entries.en: These new accelerators launch projectiles of high-energy plasma with improved containment fields. This results in less energy leakage as the projectile travels in space towards its target.

entries.zh: 最先进的等离子武器，这种火炮是之前的升级版等离子发射器完全军事化的成果。它们的等离子抛射体更加致命。
entries.en: The latest in plasma weaponry, these cannons are fully militarized versions of the older, somewhat improvised plasma throwers. Their plasma projectiles are even deadlier.

entries.zh: 该武器可以向目标发射带有混乱能量的电弧。可以在某种程度上无视装甲和护盾。
entries.en: Powerful weapons that launch a lightning arc of chaotic energy at targets, which in part can ignore armor and shields.

entries.zh: 这些升级后的发射器装备了更优秀的聚焦透镜，这使得它们可以发射出更加强大的能量。
entries.en: These upgraded emitters are equipped with better focusing lenses, resulting in a more powerful energy discharge.

entries.zh: 裂解炮发射出的高能射束，能够同时弱化并破坏构成目标原子间的分子键。它们能够穿透护盾和护甲，对敌方的船体和船员直接造成毁灭性的打击。
entries.en: Disruptors fire high-energy bolts that weaken and destroy the molecular bonds that hold the target's constituent atoms together. They are capable of passing through shields and armor to wreak havoc directly on enemy hull and crew.

entries.zh: 这些升级版的裂解炮可以对目标发射出更具威力的离子流。
entries.en: These upgraded disruptors fire bolts of more destructive ion particles at targets.

entries.zh: 这种极限强化版的裂解炮能够发射量子能，任何被命中的目标都会承受极大的伤害。
entries.en: Extremely high-yield disruptors that fire quantum energy charges causing incredible damage to those unfortunate enough to get in their way.

entries.zh: 这些能量抛射体由紧密聚集的质子组成，能够对敌方船体造成巨额伤害。
entries.en: These energy projectiles consist of tightly concentrated protons capable of causing immense damage to the hull of enemy ships.

entries.zh: 由于中子具有毁灭性的能量，升级的能量发射物将依赖中子而非质子对敌方进行打击。
entries.en: Upgraded energy projectiles that rely on neutrons instead of protons for their destructive power.

entries.zh: 利用太虚的熵特性，这种光束可以真正地摧毁能量。
entries.en: By harnessing the entropic nature of the Null Void, this beam can actually destroy energy.

entries.zh: 在低次元中使用第五维的能量操纵原理，可以造就强大的能量武器。
entries.en: Applying 5th-dimensional energy manipulation principles on lower dimensional planes allows for the creation of powerful energy weapons.

entries.zh: 使用高度聚焦透镜结合振荡发射频率来创造出足够开采小行星或击落敌人的激光。
entries.en: Using intense-focus lenses in combination with an oscillating firing frequency help create lasers strong enough to mine asteroids, or shoot down hostiles.

entries.zh: 虚空之云可以通过构成其核心的大部分的密集气体所产生的电荷来释放出燃烧的等离子体电弧。按照此原理，利用相同成分的气体配合上导管即可以制造出威力强大的闪电武器。
entries.en: Void Clouds use the electrical charges generated by the dense gases that make up most of their core to release bolts of burning plasma. Using the same gas composition together with a specialized conduit allows for powerful lightning weaponry.

entries.zh: 晶态实体以其棱镜状的躯体储存宇宙射线，并将其聚焦并以类似激光一样的光束形式释放。基于这种蓝色的棱镜模板，我们可以造出能产生相似波长能量的激光电容器。
entries.en: Crystalline Entities store stellar radiation within their prismatic bodies and can focus it to emit laser-like beams. Using the sapphire type's prismatic pattern as a base we can construct laser capacitors that produce energy at a similar wavelength.

entries.zh: 晶态实体以其棱镜状的躯体储存宇宙射线，并将其聚焦并以类似激光一样的光束形式释放。基于这种绿色的棱镜模板，我们可以造出能产生相似波长能量的激光电容器。
entries.en: Crystalline Entities store stellar radiation within their prismatic bodies and can focus it to emit laser-like beams. Using the emerald type's prismatic pattern as a base we can construct laser capacitors that produce energy at a similar wavelength.

entries.zh: 晶态实体以其棱镜状的躯体储存宇宙射线，并将其聚焦并以类似激光一样的光束形式释放。基于这种黄色的棱镜模板，我们可以造出能产生相似波长能量的激光电容器。
entries.en: Crystalline Entities store stellar radiation within their prismatic bodies and can focus it to emit laser-like beams. Using the topaz type's prismatic pattern as a base we can construct laser capacitors that produce energy at a similar wavelength.

entries.zh: 晶态实体以其棱镜状的躯体储存宇宙射线，并将其聚焦并以类似激光一样的光束形式释放。基于这种红色的棱镜模板，我们可以造出能产生相似波长能量的激光电容器。
entries.en: Crystalline Entities store stellar radiation within their prismatic bodies and can focus it to emit laser-like beams. Using the ruby type's prismatic pattern as a base we can construct laser capacitors that produce energy at a similar wavelength.

entries.zh: 在受控制的生态环境下进行水培耕作可使谷物在正常来说不可能农作的地方生长。
entries.en: Hydroponics Farming in a controlled environment allows for crops to be grown in climates where farming would normally be impossible.

entries.zh: 通过大规模工业化农场生产富含养分的农作物，可以让一个文明的人口成倍地增长。
entries.en: Large-scale industrial farms growing nutrient-rich produce allows a civilization to grow its population manifold.

entries.zh: 通过电脑来模拟各种环境与气候条件，可以使作物的产量更加可控。
entries.en: Farming techniques can be further refined through sophisticated computer simulations of different environments and weather patterns. This allows for more predictable crop yields.

entries.zh: 成熟的作物基因工程有助于进一步提高产量并改善口味和营养价值。
entries.en: Sophisticated genetic engineering of crops helps increase yield and further improves both taste and nutrient levels.

entries.zh: 在作物中融入少量的纳米机器人帮助我们创造出了一种具有极强恢复力的作物，其化学组成在整个生命周期都可以进行定制和改变。
entries.en: Infusing crop strands with small amounts of nano-machines help create a type of produce that is ultra resilient, and the chemical composition of which can be tailored and altered during its entire lifetime.

entries.zh: 虽然合成复制作物需要大量收集废料才能产生少量农产品，但这一过程仍对农业产量产生了重要的推动作用。
entries.en: The process of synthetically replicating crops requires a lot of collected waste to create a small amount of produce, but nevertheless provides a significant boost to agricultural output.

entries.zh: 一种天然存在的兴奋剂，帮助所有生命适应并演化。它也可以作为一个非常强力的能量武器导体。
entries.en: A naturally occurring stimulant that helps all forms of life adapt and evolve. It can also be used as a very potent conductor for energy weapons.

entries.zh: 在某些星球发现的这种粉尘是一种天然的兴奋剂。它对大多数人有镇静作用，可以作为一个非武力的方式安抚敌对的人。
entries.en: This fine dust is a naturally occurring stimulant found on some worlds. It has a calming effect on most beings, and can be used as a non-violent way of pacifying hostile individuals.

entries.zh: 这是一种在异星粒子中存在的极其稀有的气溶胶，随着陨石撞击被一起发现。不过其真正的来源依然是个未解之谜。若
entries.en: An extremely rare aerosol of exotic particles. It has been deposited on a number of worlds through meteor impacts, but its true origin is a mystery. If
