entries.zh: 对外星生命的研究已经超越了单纯的编目。通过研究在外星球上演化的生物体的结构和生存策略，我们在医学、适应和设计方面开辟了新的途径。
entries.en: The study of alien life has moved beyond mere cataloging. By examining the structures and survival strategies of organisms evolved under foreign stars, we open new avenues in medicine, adaptation, and design.

entries.zh: 通过递归轴突支架和突触网，我们开发了重组意识物质的电化学拓扑结构的方法。神经元不只是传递信息——它们还会缠绕、组织和记忆。现在，它们是按照我们的设计来运行。
entries.en: Through recursive axonal scaffolding and synaptic reticulation, we have developed methods for reorganizing the electrochemical topology of conscious matter. Neurons do not merely transmit - they entwine, organize, and remember. Now, they do so according to our design.

entries.zh: 生命是由重复的模式和模块化结构组成的，具有令人瞠目结舌的多样性。将其解码并在每个尺度上加以复制，我们就掌握了生物学的整体蓝图。自然界中我们所不了解的已经所剩无几，我们无法再造的事物就更少了。
entries.en: Life, in all its staggering variety, is composed of repeating patterns and modular structures. By decoding and replicating these at every scale, we now wield a holistic blueprint of biology. There is little left in nature we do not understand, and less still we cannot recreate.

entries.zh: 研究其他星球的动物群为我们的外星生物行为学研究提供了一些新见解，这使得我们可以识别和驯养温顺的个体。
entries.en: Studying the fauna of other worlds gives insight into alien behaviors, allowing us to identify and domesticate docile entities.

entries.zh: 在研究各种外星生命形态并对它们的潜在风险有了清晰的认识后，我们将能够收集活体样本并保持展出。
entries.en: Having studied various alien lifeforms and developed a clear understanding of the potential risks inherent in containing them, we would be able to collect living specimens to keep on display.

entries.zh: 计算得出建立一个行星殖民地所需的资源和设备后，我们勇敢的先驱者将驾驶大殖民船外出探索，相信他们会在远方的行星上建立新的家园。
entries.en: Calculating required resources and gear required to establish a planetary colony allows us to herd brave pioneers into grand colony ships, confident that they will survive the long voyage across the stars to a new home.

entries.zh: 因地制宜地调节大气过滤可以更好地过滤掉有害的元素，以期改善殖民地的生活条件。
entries.en: By adjusting atmospheric filtering on a per-site basis to better filter out undesirable elements, colonial living conditions may be improved.

entries.zh: 进一步研究其他行星上发现的危险环境有助于缓解殖民者在其他星球的日常生活中遇到的困难。
entries.en: Further study into the hazardous environments found on other planets help alleviate the difficulties that colonizers encounter in their day-to-day lives on foreign worlds.

entries.zh: 对多种土壤的种类及其养育作物的能力进行的大量研究使我们可以改善殖民者在其他星球上的生存条件。
entries.en: Extensive study into different soil types and their ability to support crops will help improve the living conditions of our settlers on foreign worlds.

entries.zh: 对不同行星气候的研究能够让我们的人口定居在过去我们认为过于严酷的世界。
entries.en: Additional study into different planetary climates will allow us to settle our population on worlds previously thought too hostile to support them.

entries.zh: 对经过辐射的环境进行综合研究后，我们可以在被核战争摧毁的星球上进行殖民。
entries.en: Through comprehensive study of irradiated environments we will allow our settlers to colonize worlds that have been devastated by nuclear warfare.

entries.zh: 维护私营企业和政府之间的联系，为合适的投资者提供补贴，允许私人进行殖民。
entries.en: Managing connections between the private sector and the government, giving subsidies to the right investors, allows for private initiatives into colonization.

entries.zh: 在轨建设的优先次序体现出了特定的开拓精神。
entries.en: A certain pioneering spirit manifests itself in the priorities of orbital construction.

entries.zh: 历史已经证明，集体是最有效的移民聚居的社会结构。
entries.en: History has proven collectives to be the most efficient social structure for settler enclaves.

entries.zh: 研究表明，严格的社会控制可能是保证新殖民地持续恢复力的必要条件。
entries.en: Studies indicate that strict social control may be integral to the continued resilience of young colonies.

entries.zh: 零重力环境下培育作物的确很有挑战性，但并非无法实现。
entries.en: The challenges inherent in cultivating crops in zero-G are fairly unique, but far from insurmountable.

entries.zh: 专门的庇护所和适应性生命支持系统使得在异星气候下殖民变为可能。
entries.en: Specialized shelters and adaptive life support systems allow colonization of alien climates.

entries.zh: 对异星的殖民为生物医学研究开辟了一个全新的领域。
entries.en: The colonization of alien worlds has opened up an entirely new field of biomedical research.

entries.zh: 组装新机械单位时，使用模块化部件不仅能提高组装效率，还使得未来的维修工作变得更加容易。
entries.en: The use of modular parts when assembling new machine units will both streamline the process and make future repairs easier.

entries.zh: 随着帝国日益强大，我们对生物学也更加了解。先进的细胞层面的医疗手段可以使生物人口的健康状况大幅提升。
entries.en: As our empire grows, so does our understanding of biology. Advanced medical treatments on a cellular level have allowed for significant advancements in biological population health.

entries.zh: 这些工厂其实是有自我意识的个体，只需中央机械智能提供少量信息就能够不断优化自身。
entries.en: These factories are essentially self-aware entities that continually optimize themselves with only minimal input from the central Machine Intelligence.

entries.zh: 随着无污染核聚变、自动化以及物质压缩技术的出现，从铲除山顶发展到铲除整段山脉只是时间问题了。
entries.en: With the advent of clean fusion, automation, and matter compression technologies, it was only a matter of time before mountain top removal became mountain range removal.

entries.zh: 材料科技的发展与深井开采技术可使我们在过去无法想象的深度与温度中开展地质工程。岩浆热点现在已可以进行开发，抑制甚至迁移。
entries.en: Advances in material technology and deep-shaft mining techniques allow geo-engineering at previously unthinkable depths and temperatures. Magma hotspots can now be exploited, suppressed, or even relocated.

entries.zh: 破坏自然栖息地配合围剿扫荡可以有效地在短时间内清除危险的野生动物。
entries.en: Tactical disruption of natural habitats combined with converging search-and-destroy patterns can effectively eliminate hostile wildlife in a very short span of time.

entries.zh: 通过编目分类、基因测序以及用计算机模拟外星植物生态体系，配合基因编辑与传播机理，我们可以按自己的喜好改造外星植物群落。
entries.en: Thorough cataloging, gene sequencing, and computer modeling of exobotanical ecosystems, coupled with gene editing and dispersal mechanisms, will allow us to reshape alien plant communities to our liking.

entries.zh: 土壤沉积过程通常需要数百万年的时间。应用先进的水力压裂技术、化学工程以及液压管理科技，即使最贫瘠的地层也能变成肥沃的表层土。
entries.en: The process of soil deposition normally takes millions of years. With advanced fracking, chemical engineering, and hydraulic management technologies even the poorest substrate can be turned into fertile topsoil.

entries.zh: 智慧物种从数千年前就已经开始开垦沼地。通过模块化引水渠、水泵站、化学整治装置与自动土壤压缩机之间的协调配合，我们能以前所未有的速度开垦沼地。
entries.en: Sapient races have been reclaiming swampland for thousands of years. A coordinated system of modular aqueducts, pump stations, chemical remediation crawlers and automated soil compactors can reclaim land at unprecedented speeds.

entries.zh: 只要管理得当，轨道折射镜与遮蔽装置系统可以大幅影响星球的气候。
entries.en: Orbital systems of mirrors and shades can effect dramatic changes in planetary climates, when managed properly.

entries.zh: 只要有足够的处理能力、传感器网络以及分站，即使洋流也能在一定程度上实现精确控制。
entries.en: Given enough processing power, networked sensors and distributed stations, even the ocean currents can be managed to a fine level of control.

entries.zh: 许多星球都有着巨大的地下空洞。地下探索、开发以及建造技术可以极大地增加某些星球的可居住空间。
entries.en: Many planets exhibit extensive subsurface voids. Subterranean exploration, exploitation, and construction techniques can greatly increase the habitable area of some worlds.

entries.zh: 跨星际的贸易需要我们克服新的一系列的挑战。以及时且最具成本效益的方式将货物从一个星系运输到另一个星系是至关重要的。
entries.en: Trade across interstellar distances presents a new set of challenges to overcome. It is critical to achieve the transfer of goods from one system to another in a timely and above all cost efficient manner.

entries.zh: 重塑宏观尺度的行星地壳的问题没有简单的解决方法——只有更大的铲子和轨道部署级钻头。
entries.en: There is no simple solution to the problem of macro-scale reshaping of planetary crusts - only bigger trowels and orbitally-deployed drills.

entries.zh: 湿度调节器和化学扩散装置是从根本上改变大气的第一步。
entries.en: Humidity regulators and chemical dispersal units are the first step towards a fundamentally altered atmosphere.

entries.zh: 通过改造行星生态系统使其更能适应大规模环境变化，我们能更有条不紊的进行环境改造。
entries.en: By adapting planetary ecosystems to large-scale environmental changes we can turn terraformation into a less disruptive process.

entries.zh: 通过提升我们对大气改造的理解，我们将能对大多数的生态荒芜的世界进行环境改造。
entries.en: By advancing our understanding of atmospheric transformation, we will be able to terraform even the most ecologically devastated worlds.

entries.zh: 材料科技与深井开采技术的进步使地质工程能达到前所未有的深度和温度。我们能将火山星球环境改造成温带星球。
entries.en: Advances in material technology and deep-shaft mining techniques allow geo-engineering at previously unthinkable depths and temperatures. We can terraform a Volcanic World into a temperate planet.

entries.zh: 创造盖亚星球这种适合几乎所有生命体居住的星球，是对于一个物种掌握了地貌改造艺术的至高证明。
entries.en: The creation of Gaia planets, worlds eminently suitable to almost all forms of life, is the ultimate proof of a species' mastery in the art of terraforming.

entries.zh: 通过基因测序进行个体化基因组定位开启了定制医学治疗和疗法的新纪元。
entries.en: Mapping the genome of an individual through the sequencing of their DNA opens up for tailored medical treatments and therapies.

entries.zh: 先进的DNA甲基化技术让我们可以在任意基因组上进行更具功能性的改变。
entries.en: Advanced DNA methylation techniques allow for functionally significant alterations to be made to arbitrary genomes.

entries.zh: §H解锁特性：§!表观遗传学触发器
允许我们经由物种修饰技术移除有机物种的未开智特质。
entries.en: Allows us to remove Presapient Traits from Biological Species through Species Modification.

entries.zh: 摘除术的突破和人工子宫的大规模生产技术允许个人基于一个共同的遗传模板修改自己的基因。
entries.en: Breakthroughs in enucleation and artificial womb technology allows for the mass-production of individuals based on a common genetic template.

entries.zh: 基因库筛选加上基因组管理可应用于克隆中。
entries.en: Gene Banks filter and curate available genomes for deployment in clones.

entries.zh: 通过改变腺体的生物特性，可定制物种的环境适应性。
entries.en: Through glandular biological tailoring we can change the environmental tolerance of a species to suit our needs.

entries.zh: 利用核苷酸纯化技术分离、改进遗传特质。
entries.en: Nucleotide purification techniques allow for the isolation and refinement of particularly desirable genetic traits.

entries.zh: 形态发生研究本是药学领域的尝试，但深入理解其中玄妙后，开发出了有机体潜意识直连技术。
entries.en: From its cradle as a purely pharmaceutical venture, advancements in our understanding of the morphogenetic field allow for direct, subconscious interfaces with organic units.

entries.zh: 使基因编辑工具被广泛使用肯定会对我们的发展有积极的影响。
entries.en: Making gene-editing tools widely available is sure to have a positive impact on our development as a species.

entries.zh: 对RNA转录和蛋白质翻译的在细胞层面上进行更严格的控制。
entries.en: Stricter control of RNA and protein production on the cellular level.

entries.zh: 允许我们经由物种修饰技术将§Y$trait_auto_mod_biological$§!添加给有机物种。
entries.en: Allows us to add §Y$trait_auto_mod_biological$§! to Organic Species through Species Modification.

entries.zh: §H解锁物种修饰：§!职业基因编辑
应该鼓励生育计划，以免浪费宝贵的基因传承。
entries.en: Careful reproductive planning should be incentivized, lest we waste valuable genetic legacies.

entries.zh: 我们不留漏洞、不计成本，通过严格管理基因库来造就完美的未来接班人。
entries.en: We leave nothing to chance, no matter the cost. Through exacting curation of DNA banks do we build the leaders of tomorrow.

entries.zh: 转基因的硅基细菌可被操控进行非有机材料的再生。
entries.en: A genetically altered version of silicon-based bacteria could potentially be manipulated to regenerate non-organic materials.

entries.zh: 肉体失败的地方，就让科学介入吧。
entries.en: Where the body fails, science intervenes.

entries.zh: 硅基生物和碳基生物具有许多相似性，这能让我们将石质类生物的进化特质同碳基生物结合起来。
entries.en: The similarities between silicon based and carbon based life allow us to synthesize Lithoid evolutionary traits in carbon based species.

entries.zh: §H解锁特性：§!石质类转基因技术
允许我们经由物种修饰技术将石质类特质添加给有机物种。
entries.en: Allows us to add Lithoid Traits to Biological Species through Species Modification.

entries.zh: 通过一些人工的促长手段，我们在植物类物种中发现的进化适应性也可以复制到其他形式的生命体中。
entries.en: With some artificial encouragement, the evolutionary adaptations found in botanical species can be replicated in other forms of life.

entries.zh: §H解锁特性：§!植物体转基因技术
允许我们经由物种修饰技术将植物类特质添加给有机物种。
entries.en: Allows us to add Botanical Traits to Organic Species through Species Modification.

entries.zh: 游荡于星辰间的巨兽对于在群星间存活具有极其令人瞩目的适应性。掌控这些特质会是我们在基因领域的巨大胜利。
entries.en: Galactic fauna have remarkable adaptions to life in interstellar space. Mastery of these traits will be our genetic triumph.

entries.zh: §H解锁特性：§!星神兽转基因技术
允许我们经由物种修饰技术将星神兽特质添加给有机物种。
entries.en: Allows us to add Leviathan Traits to Organic Species through Species Modification.

entries.zh: 逐步适应深空作战的现实使我们能够有效地协调更大规模的调动。
entries.en: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.

entries.zh: 逐步适应深空作战的现实使我们能够有效地协调更大规模的调动。
entries.en: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.

entries.zh: 逐步适应深空作战的现实使我们能够有效地协调更大规模的调动。
entries.en: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.

entries.zh: 逐步适应深空作战的现实使我们能够有效地协调更大规模的调动。
entries.en: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.

entries.zh: 逐步适应深空作战的现实使我们能够有效地协调更大规模的调动。
entries.en: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.

entries.zh: 要是没有强大的命令管理其行为，多么完善的战斗知识体系都是没用的。
entries.en: A body of knowledge regarding combat behaviors is useless without a strong code governing its use.

entries.zh: 重构指挥链并判定军官间应有的依赖关系能够使舰队更加可靠高效。
entries.en: Restructuring the chain of command and deciding what interdependencies are set between officers, make fleets more responsive and effective.

entries.zh: 随着系外远征变得更加普遍，为归来的舰队提供行星侧的补给非常重要。
entries.en: As extrasolar expeditions become more common, it is important to provide planetside relief for returning fleets.

entries.zh: 一支舰队的运行不能仅凭一腔热血，为了确保能稳定地获得重要的补给，我们必须将后勤军队组织成专门的支援舰船。
entries.en: A fleet does not run on zeal alone. To ensure steady access to critical supplies, we should organize our logistics corps into dedicated support vessels.

entries.zh: 新手谈论战术，专家研究后勤。我们可以通过确保舰队能够定期而高效地获得补给，来增加我们能够有效地支持的舰船数量。
entries.en: Amateurs talk about tactics. Professionals study logistics. By ensuring our fleets are regularly and efficiently supplied, we can increase the number of vessels we can effectively support.

entries.zh: 通过维持一支专业的舰队联络队伍，我们可以改善指挥链中的命令传达与通讯。
entries.en: By maintaining a professional corps of fleet liaisons, we can improve communications and the flow of orders throughout the chain of command.

entries.zh: 升级和改造船部件的标准化工作流程能促进大规模的效率提升。
entries.en: Standardizing workflows for upgrading and retrofitting ship components can lead to massive efficiency gains.

entries.zh: 通过建立训练设施，自主子个体可以学习如何指挥低等同胞，这样可以获得更高的战场灵活性和效率。
entries.en: By establishing training facilities where the autonomous drones can learn to command their lesser brethren, we will achieve greater battlefield flexibility and effectiveness.

entries.zh: 为各级军事行动打造专门的指挥部以形成高效的舰队，为未来的军事训练打下良好的基础。
entries.en: Creating dedicated headquarters for all levels of military operations shapes an efficient fleet, and lays a better foundation for future military training.

entries.zh: 所有机械都需要维护，对战体而言尤为甚至。专门的维修团队可以将磨损维持到最低，并减少修理费用。
entries.en: All machines require maintenance, and this is especially true for warforms. A dedicated maintenance corps will keep attritional breakdowns to a minimum and decrease repair costs.

entries.zh: 这是为新兵准备的更完善的培训计划，包括现实的战斗场景，让他们做好进入战场的准备。
entries.en: A more extensive training program for new recruits, including realistic combat scenarios, prepare them for the field.

entries.zh: 为我们的地面作战单位配备技术数据库，他们就可以在战场上进行诊断和有限的自我维修。
entries.en: By equipping our combat ground units with technical databases, they can perform diagnostics and limited self-repair in the field.

entries.zh: 有很多外星帝国希望将我们的星球据为己有。我们必须要做好万全的准备。
entries.en: There are many alien empires who would gladly seize our worlds for themselves. We must be prepared for them, should the worst come to pass.

entries.zh: 良好的防御在今天的重要程度丝毫不逊于我们祖先所生活的中古时代。技术的进步不会使防御工事过时，只会改变它们的存在形式和强度。
entries.en: The strategic value of a good defense remains as relevant today as it was to our predecessors in the far distant past. Technology does not render fortifications obsolete - it merely changes their requirements.

entries.zh: 心灵往往是宇宙自身的映射，也是一个小宇宙。并不是谁都会触及到如此深层的洞见，但他们的心灵却会是无上的器具。
entries.en: The mind is in many ways a reflection of the universe itself, a microcosmos. Not all beings will reach this level of insight, but their minds are tools greater than any other.

entries.zh: $tech_telepathy_desc.1$就能与他人建立思想连接，实现升格。
entries.en: $tech_telepathy_desc.1$ the mind is capable of connecting to other individuals, becoming something greater.

entries.zh: 一旦完全接纳了灵能的根基，
entries.en: Once fully adapted to the basics of Psionics,

entries.zh: $tech_telepathy_desc.1$我们的$getbrainname_machine$就能触及到集体网络之外。
entries.en: $tech_telepathy_desc.1$ our $getbrainname_machine$ can extend beyond the collective network.

entries.zh: $tech_telepathy_desc.1$我们的$getbrainname_hive$就能触及到集体网络之外。
entries.en: $tech_telepathy_desc.1$ our $getbrainname_hive$ can extend beyond the collective network.

entries.zh: $tech_telepathy_desc.1$我们的$getbrainname_wilderness$就能触及到集体网络之外。
entries.en: $tech_telepathy_desc.1$ our $getbrainname_wilderness$ can extend beyond the collective network.

entries.zh: 不断探索灵能领域，读取心灵波动先于获得实际感知，从而制造出预知接口作战计算机。
entries.en: Advances in the field of Psionics suggest the possibility of creating combat computers capable of reading and analyzing the impulses of telepathic operatives before they are cognitively processed.

entries.zh: 灵能跳跃引擎利用船员放射的灵能使舰体穿越现实的空间结构，立即“跳跃”过超长的距离。
entries.en: The Psi Jump Drive harnesses the psi energies emitted by the crew to force the vessel through the very fabric of reality, instantly "jumping" vast distances.

entries.zh: 星际贸易表面上与一般交易类似，但其中错综复杂却远胜于之，任何土著文明的贸易史都相形见绌。
entries.en: The intricacies of interstellar trade closely resemble that of any other transaction, but is performed on a scale dwarfing the entire history of trade for most pre-FTL civilizations.

entries.zh: 由于星际外交极度复杂，为了达成自身目标，必须与其他势力结交。
entries.en: The complexities of interstellar diplomacy necessitate the forming of bonds with foreign powers in order to further one's goals.

entries.zh: 踏足星系浊流的唯一目标即登上巅峰。
entries.en: We navigate a minefield of galactic power dynamics with a singular purpose; to come out on top.

entries.zh: 理解如何影响和操纵异种，是建立长久星际联盟的必由之路。
entries.en: Advancing our understanding of interactions with - and manipulations of - the xeno is a necessary step in forming more permanent interstellar alliances.

entries.zh: 一个联邦不仅仅是善意和共同的雄心。这份准则为统一的星际秩序奠定了基础，确保其成员之间的合作与稳定。
entries.en: A Federation must be more than goodwill and shared ambition. This code provides the groundwork for a unified interstellar order, ensuring cooperation and stability among its members.

entries.zh: 我们的未来在浩瀚的星海。
entries.en: Our future lies in the sea of stars.

entries.zh: 勇敢抓住命运，成为天命所归。
entries.en: We must have to courage to seize our fate and make true what was always meant to be.

entries.zh: 枪杆子里面出政权。强者为所欲为。
entries.en: A well-oiled war machine is the key to exerting influence on a galactic scale. Backed by the might of our military, we can lay claim to almost anything we want.

entries.zh: 改革政体，增强军备，从而无远弗届。
entries.en: Further improvements to administration grant an extended power projection across the stars, and the military clout needed to enforce our demands.

entries.zh: 当生存本身受到威胁时，战争这一概念便失去了意义。这些战役的发动并非为了统治，而是为了确保我们文明的存续。
entries.en: When survival itself is at stake, the very concept of war loses its meaning. These campaigns are waged not for dominion, but to secure the continued existence of our civilization.

entries.zh: 殖民地建立完毕后，开拓者就变成了公民，殖民时期的灵活机关也就必须转变为能维持稳定的强力地方政府。
entries.en: Once a colony has been firmly established and pioneers turn into citizens, the need for a strong local government providing stability trumps the colonial need for flexibility.

entries.zh: 只有面向我们的网络进行专门化的基础设施建设，我们的殖民地才能实现稳定的运转。
entries.en: Our colonies would never achieve stable operation without infrastructure dedicated to our networked self.

entries.zh: 如果不能将集体意识进行稳定的投射，我们的殖民地会枯萎归零。我们不辞辛劳地现身是保证蜂群繁荣昌盛的关键。
entries.en: Our colonies would wither to naught without the stable projection of our collective self. Our effortless presence ensures a flourishing hive.

entries.zh: 上古时期的诸国家、部族曾经兵戎相见，然而现在一切都统一在帝国的旗帜之下。我们绝不会，也永远不会，灭亡。
entries.en: Ancient warring tribes, historical nations in conflict, now unified in empire. We must not, will not, crumble.

entries.zh: 我们为了求生存而死命战斗的生态熔炉已经在我们的基因记忆中蚀刻了一条强健的道路。我们集所有曾来此地的存在于一统。
entries.en: The ecological crucible in which we fought for survival has etched sturdy paths into our genetic memory. We are the peerless union of all that came before.

entries.zh: 由于发展需要，新时代政府形式必须更加灵活有效，而不是碍手碍脚。
entries.en: The progress we make calls for a new, nimbler form of administration that may aid rather than hinder us in our pursuits.

entries.zh: 相比早期型号，正电子处理器造价低廉、生产快速，有利于引入额外领袖单位。
entries.en: Positronic CPUs are both cheaper and faster to produce than previous models, allowing us to press additional leader units into service.

entries.zh: 用于处理和组织海量数据的先进算法可以大幅度优化我们在全帝国范围内的决策效率和信息共享能力。
entries.en: Improved algorithms for processing and organizing vast amounts of data has streamlined decision-making and information-sharing throughout the empire.

entries.zh: 地区管理技术的进步使得我们可以对殖民地事务进行进一步的监控，而不会过度增加中央决策机构的负担。
entries.en: Local administrative developments allow for closer supervision of colonial affairs without excessively burdening central decision-making.

entries.zh: 多层级行政效果显著，帝国高层只负责处理最关键事物。
entries.en: Multiple administrative strata efficiently surface only the most vital information to the upper levels of government.

entries.zh: 健全地方政府管理体制，因地制宜地满足各个殖民地的需要。
entries.en: Robust frameworks for local governance created on a per-case basis, to meet each colony's needs.

entries.zh: 星际帝国行政事务繁多，问题复杂。着手妥善应对。
entries.en: The administrative needs of a star empire are as numerous as they are complex. We will rise to the occasion.

entries.zh: 帝国生生不息。我们构筑成为帝国的躯体，但左膀无需知道右臂在做什么。
entries.en: The Empire lives, the Empire breathes. We may make up its body, but it is not for the left hand to know what the right hand is doing.

entries.zh: 半自主的单位是大局成功的关键。
entries.en: Semi-independent units have proved critical to the success of the greater whole.

entries.zh: 团体内的求同存异是自然而然且不可避免的；最终，同性一定会比个性发挥更大的价值。
entries.en: Finding aspects of the self within the group is natural and inevitable; eventually those shared aspects must be valued higher than individual identities.

entries.zh: 有必要向我们的自主领袖单位提倡积极主动和抱负，但同时也要确保他们不会偏离核心智能的指示。
entries.en: Initiative and some measure of ambition must be promoted in our autonomous leader units, while still making certain that they do not stray too far from the directives of the core intelligence.

entries.zh: 禁锢他人的同时释放自我是一项困难异常的思维杂技——现在我们得益于更为先进的装备终于可以达成这项壮举了。
entries.en: Limiting the freedoms of others while preserving one's own may require unusual mental acrobatics - a feat we are now better-equipped to perform.

entries.zh: 所谓认知，不过是对感官信号的处理而已。它是可以被改变的。
entries.en: Cognition is little but the processing of sensory input. It can be altered.

entries.zh: 星球很大，而生产设施之间通常也相隔着很远的距离。我们需要一个协调策略，来确保每个人都在朝着相同的方向努力。
entries.en: Planets are big and production sites are often separated by vast distances. A coherent strategy for making certain that everyone is pulling in the same direction is often needed.

entries.zh: 痛觉模拟器的出现打破了虚拟和现实之间的最后一堵墙。
entries.en: The advent of accurate pain emulators will at long last bridge the divide between the virtual and the real.

entries.zh: 赞颂精神、肌体或目的的纯净性，具体内容则要依我们的目标而定。
entries.en: A celebration of purity, perhaps of spirit, or of the body, or purpose - dependent on whatever goal we have in mind.

entries.zh: 随着我们更多更深地了解这个星系的奥秘，重申我们的信仰并将我们的人民团结在同一面旗帜下的需求日益迫切。
entries.en: As we explore more of the galaxy and its wonders, it becomes increasingly important for us to reaffirm our beliefs and to unify our people under one symbol.

entries.zh: 在了解到我们于太空中并不孤独后，我们应当做好准备，迎接这些新朋友的到来。
entries.en: As we learn that we are not alone in space, we should begin preparations to welcome our new-found friends.

entries.zh: 在感官改造工程与娱乐体验革命性交叉领域中，深层组织植入体无疑是先进的新发明。“我之所在，皮囊不将束之。”
entries.en: Deep-tissue implants are the latest innovation in the revolutionary overlapping of sensory engineering and entertainment experiences. "Where we're going, we won't need skin to feel!"

entries.zh: 有了最先进的建筑学、景观学及全息影像技术，我们将建造一个真正的未来家园。
entries.en: With the latest advances in architecture, landscaping and holographic technology, we shall build the homes of the future.

entries.zh: 具体情境规定了到底什么是道德的。若拥有定义情景的能力，伦理道德不过手中黏土，可以随意摆弄。
entries.en: It is circumstance that dictates what is moral. Define the circumstances, and ethics is like clay in your hands.

entries.zh: 跳出囹圄思考，唯一能够发现的是明白自己身处另一个更大的囹圄之内。
entries.en: Thinking outside the box merely places you in another, somewhat larger box.

entries.zh: 如果说权力是将自己的意愿强加于他人的能力，那么权力意志就是一种自证预言。
entries.en: As power is simply the ability to impose one's will on others, the will to power is a self-fulfilling prophecy.

entries.zh: 一个人的目标就是所有人的目标。唯有齐心协力，方可众志成城。
entries.en: The purpose of one is the purpose of all. Together, we are greater than the sum of our parts.

entries.zh: 以迥乎不同的成分构建出的整体将大于其各部分之和。
entries.en: From disparate components do we build a whole greater than the sum of its parts.

entries.zh: 唯有理解了我们的共同历史，方可一起大步迈向未来。
entries.en: An understanding of a shared past is necessary in order to make any significant strides into the future.

entries.zh: 对我们迄今为止走过的路的纪念。既是为了向过去的成就致敬，也为了激励我们勇敢走向未来。
entries.en: Physical reminders of how far we have come both instill a reverence for past achievements and bolster ambitions for the future.

entries.zh: 潜意识重点测试的发明大大改善了我们市场营销部门的效率。如能将这些方法应用到我们的智慧生命资源管理部门，将使我们成为企业管理方面的新标杆。
entries.en: The invention of subconscious focus-testing has led to immense efficiency gains in our marketing and sales departments. By applying these methods to our sapient resource departments, we will achieve a bold new paradigm in corporate management.

entries.zh: 单位之间几乎瞬时的信息交流十分重要。
entries.en: The near-instantaneous transfer of information and instructions between units is of critical importance.

entries.zh: 并不是所有关于超光速通讯频道的研究都是有用功，但是其中某些成果也许会找到将我们的人民团结在一起的新目的。
entries.en: Not all research into faster-than-light communication channels produces useful results, but some outcomes may find new purpose in bringing our people together.

entries.zh: 只能以亚光速进行企业协作的时代早已成为过去。现在是超光速经济的新时代，而我们的企业文化也必须克服过时的相对论带来的限制。
entries.en: The days when corporate synergy could only be achieved at sublight speeds are long gone. This is a bold new age of faster-than-light economics, and our corporate culture must adapt to overcome its outmoded relativistic constraints.

entries.zh: 对种类迥异的数据集进行的持续而非同步的分析允许我们对于社会潮流中迄今为止难以预测的浪潮进行精准的数学建模。
entries.en: Continuous, asynchronous analysis of disparate data sets allows for the accurate modeling of hitherto-unpredictable fluctuations in social currents.

entries.zh: 这是一座巨大的金库，公开展示我们公司的许多辉煌的成果，员工将从这些成功的接管经历中汲取灵感，并从被收购的公司不能很好地融入我们更宏大的商业战略的失败经历中获得警示。
entries.en: A massive vault with public displays of our corporation's many glorious acquisitions will let employees draw inspiration from successful takeovers, and take warning of what happens when acquired companies fail to properly mesh into our broader business strategy.

entries.zh: 所有的信息路径都导向枢纽，主级机械智能能够在空闲时随时分析编译数据。
entries.en: All informational pathways lead to the Hub, where the primary Machine Intelligence can analyze and interpret the data at its leisure.
Seeing is believing, and belief begets reality.

entries.zh: 通过我们对物理以及力场操纵的理解，我们神圣的领域将为所有的个体所见所感。
entries.en: Through our understanding of physics and field manipulation, our holy places shall we seen and felt by all.

entries.zh: 离开母星的摇篮为我们开启了理解信仰的新大门，而信仰的位置被摆在了更广阔的背景中。
entries.en: Leaving our planetary cradle has opened us up to a new understanding of faith, and its place in a wider context.

entries.zh: 先进归化中心的引进会给每个来到我们帝国的新成员提供特殊装备，以确保他们能适应新的社会，同时还可以保留他们天生的优势。
entries.en: The introduction of advanced naturalization centers will ensure that any newcomers to our empire are uniquely equipped to navigate their adoptive society, while preserving their native strengths.

entries.zh: 通过调整太空变形虫的繁育流程，我们可以将其共生鞭毛改造为我们海军的生物舰载机。
entries.en: By altering the breeding process of Space Amoebas, we can program their symbiotic flagella to act as organic strike craft for our navy.

entries.zh: 从击败的索林原虫处收集样本能使我们克隆其基因并进行重编程，从而造出我们自己的战斗武器。
entries.en: Collecting specimens from defeated Prethoryn enables us to clone and genetically program a war-brood of our own.

entries.zh: 通过分析虫群使用的生物武器，我们可以造出同样可怕的自航炮弹用以传播杀伤。
entries.en: By analyzing the biological weaponry employed by the Swarm we can create self-propelled projectiles weapons spreading the very same horrific destruction.

entries.zh: 改进缇扬奇提取气态物质的能量的方法，就有可能造出可以从敌方舰船中汲取能量的武器。
entries.en: Adapting the Tiyanki method of siphoning energy from gaseous matter, it is possible to construct weapons draining energy from enemy ships.

entries.zh: 评估矿物沉积的变动形式可以帮助建立更有效的钻探模式。
entries.en: Changes in how mineral deposits are evaluated relative to each other lead to more efficient boring patterns.

entries.zh: 交联武器系统发射的交错式齐射可以极大提升防御站的伤害。
entries.en: Cross-linking weapon systems to fire in staggered volleys improves the actual damage output of Military Stations over time.

entries.zh: 额外的内部装甲结构可以提高防御站的耐久。
entries.en: Additional layers of armor plating within the structure itself improves the resilience of Military Stations.

entries.zh: 进一步提高船上空间的划分水平可以让舰体完整性在下降到危险水平之前承受更多的伤害。
entries.en: Further increasing compartmentalization of shipboard spaces allows ships to sustain more damage before hull integrity reaches critically low levels.

entries.zh: 把合适的材料压缩成超高密度，是一种便宜又有效的提高防护力的方式。
entries.en: Compressing suitable materials into ultra-dense forms is a cheap and efficient way to improve their ability to absorb weapons-grade impacts.

entries.zh: 得益于火箭上的微处理器严格控制的化学反应，现有的弹头可以在爆炸时发挥出最大的威力。
entries.en: With the chemical reaction tightly controlled by missile-board microprocessors, warhead detonations can be tuned for maximum effect for local conditions at the time of impact.

entries.zh: 小型化技术的进步可以让火箭拥有更快的装载与卸货速度。
entries.en: Advances in miniaturization allow for more rapid loading and discharging of rocket-propelled payloads.

entries.zh: 超高密度的子弹可以击穿最强大的护盾。
entries.en: Ultra-dense slugs can punch through even the strongest of projected shields.

entries.zh: 小小的技术进步加上改良的船只管理规程，可以让射速显著提高。
entries.en: Minor technical advances combine with improved shipboard routines for handling munitions to provide a noticeable boost in fire rate.

entries.zh: 轻微改善传输效率可以相当大的减少总能量损失。
entries.en: Minor improvements to transmission efficiency adds up to a sizeable reduction in overall energy loss.

entries.zh: 舰体护盾的基本力学是很复杂的，但是他们可以用多种方式进行调整和改进。
entries.en: The basic mechanics of ship shields are complex, but they can be adjusted and improved in a multitude of ways.

entries.zh: 完善激光武器的发射节奏是一个可以让任何行星的工程精英忙几个世纪的任务。
entries.en: Perfecting the firing cadence of laser weaponry is a task that could keep the engineering elite of any given planet busy for centuries.

entries.zh: 可以定期冷却表面的新科技，提高了我们的武器系统的稳定性和效率。让它们在使用的时候不至于炸掉我们的舰船。
entries.en: New developments in tech cooling regularly surface, improving the stability and efficiency of our weapons systems, keeping them from blowing up the ships upon which they are mounted.

entries.zh: 提高战斗机飞行员处理敌人位置信息并做出反应的速度，提高战斗机在战场食物链中的位置。
entries.en: Increasing the speed at which fighter pilots can process and act upon enemy positioning data elevates strike craft a few steps up the food chain.

entries.zh: 通过收集和分析曾来过此地的飞行员的表现数据，我们能够指数型地改善我们训练飞行员的方法。每一个来过此地受训的人都会变得更加迅速。
entries.en: By collecting and analyzing the performance data of the pilots that came before, we have exponentially improved our pilot training methods. Each one will be quicker than the one that came before.

entries.zh: 我们的舰队越来越远离祖先的家园，我们的传感科技也不断突破极限。
entries.en: As our fleets roam every further from our ancestral home, our sensor technology continuously pushes past the limits of old.

entries.zh: 计算模型的日益强大使得单体建筑项目能够更好地适应星球的极端重力条件。
entries.en: Increasingly powerful computation paradigms allow us to adapt individual construction projects to planetary and ultra-local gravitational conditions.

entries.zh: 博弈论和模糊理论的应用具有大幅优化模块组装和建造的潜力。
entries.en: The application of game and puzzle theory has the potential to greatly optimize modular assembly and construction.

entries.zh: 仅仅一盒转基因作物就能提供多种普通食物的营养元素。
entries.en: Transgenic crops offer the nutritional elements of several standard food crops in one convenient package.

entries.zh: 改进过的超光速通讯频道可以传达更连贯的管理指令。
entries.en: Improved FTL communication channels allow for more coherent administrative direction.

entries.zh: 将联系核心世界的行政网汇集于首都，可以减少新帝国时常出现的行政压力和信息阻塞。
entries.en: Restructuring the managerial web linking core worlds to the capital can help alleviate the administrative stressors and information chokepoints that frequently arise within a budding empire.

entries.zh: 将人口作为一种资源在更大的生产系统内进行管理，这种概念的潜力越来越巨大，因此必须变得越来越灵活。
entries.en: The concept of managing individuals as resources within larger systems of production must, by necessity, become more flexible as the potential natures of the managed individuals grow ever more numerous.

entries.zh: 利用宣传和被精巧控制的经济数据，减少雇佣顶级领袖的费用。
entries.en: Propaganda programs and subtle manipulation of economic records drive down the cost of employing top-tier Leaders.

entries.zh: 新启动的人格矩阵通常有风险陷入疯狂或无用的思考，这就导致了要花费昂贵的资源与大量的时间进行代码校准。更好的保障措施能降低这个风险。
entries.en: A freshly booted personality matrix always runs the risk of descending into madness or unproductive obsessions, resulting in expensive and time-consuming code redactions. Better safeguards will reduce this risk.

entries.zh: 利用更加激进的信息战，增加公众对法令的接受程度。
entries.en: More aggressive information campaigns improve the populace's receptiveness to Edicts.

entries.zh: 让地面部队学习标准的环境生存法，可以让他们在正面作战时更强大。
entries.en: Iterating on the standard conditioning regimen for ground troops has proven to make them more effective in direct combat.

entries.zh: 小心地调整疼痛接收器，可以让士兵在受到致命伤后仍能坚持战斗。
entries.en: Careful tuning of pain receptors allow soldiers to fight through what would previously have been debilitating injuries.

entries.zh: 周期性细胞再生疗法能让领袖阶层保持活力，延年益寿。
entries.en: Regimens of periodic cell revitalization treatments keep the leader class spry and active beyond traditionally expected lifespans.

entries.zh: 维持恒星基地所需的庞大后勤补给网络得到了进一步改善，现在我们能建造更多恒星基地了。
entries.en: The immense logistical support networks needed to maintain an upgraded Starbase can be further improved, allowing us to support more of these stations.

entries.zh: 化学优化过的饮食，让签约的工人发挥出非同一般的生产力。
entries.en: Chemically optimizing diets for indentured workers allow them to perform above projected productivity curves.

entries.zh: 改善舰队管理规程将腾出资源，用以维持更大的舰队。
entries.en: Improved fleet management procedures will free up the resources needed to maintain a bigger fleet.

entries.zh: 强化指挥官的幕僚人员，将增加其在一支舰队中可统领的舰船数量。
entries.en: Improving the support staff available to our commanders will increase the number of ships they can lead in a single fleet.

entries.zh: 启用大额晶体赏金法令。

entries.en: §HCovert Operations Path§!\n§EThis technology will lead to further advancements in espionage and covert activities.§!

entries.zh: §H基建之道§!\n§E这项科技将进一步推进民用基础设施的发展。§!
entries.en: §HInfrastructure Path§!\n§EThis technology will lead to further advancements in civilian infrastructure.§!

entries.en: §HCloaking Path§!\n§EThis technology will lead to further advancements in cloaking field generators.§!

entries.en: §HDetection Path§!\n§EThis technology will lead to further advancements in detection of cloaked fleets.§!

entries.en: §HNode Culling Path§!\n§EThis technology will lead to further advancements in Node Culling Agendas.§!

entries.zh: §H乡村区划特化路线§!\n§E这项科技将进一步引领乡村区划的特化工程领域的进步与发展。§!
entries.en: §HRural District Specialization Path§!\n§EThis technology will lead to further advancements in Specializing Rural Districts.§!

entries.zh: 这些船载实验设施集成了古代策展人的先进科技，能够进一步增加调查速度。
entries.en: These shipboard lab facilities incorporate advanced technologies from the ancient Curator Order to further increase survey speeds.

entries.zh: 舰载实验室装备有先进的考古学装备，包括由策展人提供的大容量数据库，新的发现可以很容易地在其中标注出来。
entries.en: A shipboard lab with advanced archaeological equipment, including a vast database supplied by the Curator Order where new discoveries can easily be cross-referenced.

entries.zh: 通过足够先进的数学仿真，也许有可能在一定程度上预测有机物种的经济浮动。我们可以借机操控他们的股市为我们牟利。
entries.en: Through sufficiently advanced mathematical simulations, it may be possible to predict the fluctuating economies of organic society in some limited fashion. This would let us manipulate their stock markets to our advantage.

entries.zh: 这些先进的内驱程序比早先版本量级更轻，能让机器人单位为子系统分配额外的空间。
entries.en: These advanced motivators are both smaller and lighter than previous versions, allowing robotic units to allocate additional space for subsystems.

entries.zh: 使用程控的纳米机器人辅助建造新机器单位，使其拥有配备了更多子系统的更为先进的模板。
entries.en: Using programmable nanites to assist in the construction of new robotic units will allow for more advanced models that are equipped with an even greater array of subsystems.

entries.zh: 有机生命体经常采用不合逻辑且不可预测的战术，这对我们来说很难有效应对。但采用自适应的战术以及新的、机动性更好的战体将能提供决定性的优势。
entries.en: Organics often fight using illogical and unpredictable tactics that can be difficult to effectively counter. Adaptive tactics and new, more maneuverable warforms should provide a decisive advantage.

entries.zh: 经过数百万年坚持不懈的进化，有机生命有时也会进化出优雅简洁的解决方案，这可以应用到机械设计中。
entries.en: Millions of years of organic evolution will sometimes, through sheer persistence, produce elegant solutions that can also be applied to machine designs.

entries.zh: 在可控环境中研究捕获的黑洞有巨大的研究价值。
entries.en: A captive black hole that can be studied in a controlled environment would be an incredible research asset.

entries.zh: 配有显微设备的复制机能够让我们复制出带有更多复杂细节的无人机。
entries.en: Microscopic tools that can assist our replication units in creating the more complex circuitry needed for new drones.

entries.zh: 仿照有机物DNA而来，这些微型机械智能可以自动组成大多数新无人机需要的零件。
entries.en: Modelled on organic DNA, these microscopic machine intellects are capable of autonomously assembling most components needed for new drones.
